token: runtime code hash matches the token policy snapshot
token0 and token1 identities match pool or position state
fee-on-transfer, rebasing, callback, and non-standard approve behavior are explicitly classified
recipient: swap and refund recipient equals wallet owner
minted NFT recipient equals wallet owner
collect and sweep recipient equals wallet owner
deadline: deadline is positive, bounded, digest-bound, and later than execution time
quote max block has not passed
minOut: bound to route, amount, slippage, expiry, and digest
fee: recipient is present in the exact registry fee policy
bps is within the exact versioned maximum and bound to digest
receipt transfers reconcile to recipient and bps
codeHash: Helper, factory or poolManager, positionManager, Permit2, router, spender, wrapped native, and governed tokens match registry hashes
verification occurs at the planned execution block
proxy implementation and admin slots are included when a registered component is a proxy
any read failure or mismatch degrades the capability

threatCases.attack: caller differs from immutable Helper owner or wallet operation owner
threatCases.requiredControl: owner equality before asset pull, approval, combination call, refund, or sweep
threatCases.expected: revert or reject with no state or balance change

threatCases.attack: callback reentry, false return, fee-on-transfer, rebase, approve race, oversized return data, or gas griefing
threatCases.requiredControl: token policy, safe return handling, balance-delta accounting, bounded gas, reentrancy guard, and explicit unsupported-token rejection
threatCases.expected: atomic revert or quarantined reconciliation; no unbounded allowance or stranded NFT

threatCases.attack: unknown target, spender, selector, code hash, token transfer injection, recipient rewrite, or arbitrary calldata
threatCases.requiredControl: exact registry identity, non-empty selector allowlist, decoded token and recipient checks, calldata digest, and simulation

threatCases.attack: token, router, native recipient, or manager callback enters another asset-changing path
threatCases.requiredControl: single cross-function reentrancy lock plus checks-effects-interactions and no externally controlled callback target
threatCases.expected: reentrant call reverts and the outer transaction remains atomic

threatCases.attack: increase, collect, or decrease an NFT not owned by or approved for the wallet and Helper
threatCases.requiredControl: ownerOf, getApproved, isApprovedForAll, tokenId, manager, and snapshot checks at execution

threatCases.attack: residual token or native balance is hidden, accumulated, or redirected
threatCases.requiredControl: per-asset pre/post balances, explicit thresholds, owner-only refund, residual state, and sweep reconciliation
threatCases.expected: success only below threshold; otherwise Helper becomes residual and blocks new funding

threatCases.attack: unbounded, stale, wrong-spender, replayed, or unexpectedly persistent ERC-20 or Permit2 authority
threatCases.requiredControl: exact spender, bounded amount and expiration, zero-first compatibility, post-state read, and revoke recovery
threatCases.expected: mismatch enters reconciliation and prevents later asset steps

threatCases.attack: wrong msg.value, WBNB identity, unwrap amount, native recipient, or callback behavior
threatCases.requiredControl: registered wrapped-native address and hash, exact value accounting, owner recipient, and pre/post native plus WBNB deltas
threatCases.expected: atomic revert or exact owner credit with bounded Helper dust

threatCases.attack: refund omitted, duplicated, sent to another recipient, or reported without a balance delta
threatCases.requiredControl: immutable owner recipient, per-asset expected residual, canonical receipt, transfer events, and balance reconciliation
threatCases.expected: operation cannot succeed until refund and dust reconcile

requiredAssertions: no unexpected token or NFT movement
owner, allowance, refund, and dust bounds hold

releaseGates: versioned fee recipient and bps policy
Foundry unit, fuzz, and invariant suite
Anvil fork success and failure fixtures
independent contract and execution security review
